summary: Smoke test of UltimateArbitrageHFT MVP. Backend: 19/19 endpoints verified (auth, bot control/config, market spreads/opps, trades, pnl, wallet, logs, telegram). Frontend: 23/23 UI flow checks passed (login, dashboard cards, start/stop/mode toggle, all sidebar nav pages, config save persistence, 7 wallet cards, logout, bad-creds error). End-to-end integration between FastAPI + React + MongoDB is working with the mock background engine. NOTE: /app/memory/test_credentials.md was missing; used credentials from backend .env (admin@arbhft.io / Admin@123) as supplied in the review request.
passed: GET /api/auth/me without auth -> 401; with Bearer -> 200 user
POST /api/bot/action stop -> status=stopped; start -> running; invalid -> 400
GET /api/wallet/balances returns 7 exchanges with balances + total_usd + connected
GET /api/logs returns recent INFO log lines from background engine
GET /api/telegram/config (masked) + PUT updates; POST /api/telegram/test -> 400 without creds, 200 {ok:true,delivered:true} after PUT
Frontend Login screen loads at /; correct creds -> Dashboard; wrong creds -> visible login-error
Dashboard renders master-control-card, bot-status-text, pnl-today/24h/total/winrate cards, opportunities-card, recent-trades-card
Start/Stop buttons toggle bot-status-text RUNNING<->STOPPED visibly; Paper/Live mode buttons toggle without error
Sidebar nav routes work: Spreads, Trades, Wallet (7 wallet-card-* tiles), Config, Logs (logs-viewer visible), Telegram
Config page: editing min-spread to 0.42 and Save persists (input still shows 0.42 after refetch)
